content.name: Rohan Kulkarni
content.title: Junior Accountant
content.summary: CA Intermediate-qualified commerce graduate preparing for CA Final, with two years of articleship and a first in-house role at a pharmaceutical packaging company. Files GST and TDS returns, reconciles vendor ledgers in Tally Prime, and recovered ₹6.8 lakh of input tax credit missed in the previous year.

experience.title: Junior Accountant
bullets: Prepare monthly GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B returns and reconcile purchase registers with GSTR-2B for 310 suppliers.
Recovered ₹6.8 lakh of eligible input tax credit by matching last year's unreconciled invoices with vendors.
Compute TDS on contractor, rent and professional payments and file quarterly returns on time.
Reconcile vendor ledgers in Tally Prime each month and chase 40+ open debit notes.

experience.title: Articled Assistant
bullets: Took part in statutory and tax audits of 18 clients including traders, a cooperative bank and a hospital trust.
Vouched sales, purchase and expense entries and prepared draft audit observations for partner review.
Prepared income tax returns for 60 individual and partnership clients each filing season.
Drafted Form 3CD tax audit reports under partner supervision.
